bio.text: Jonathan Steinberg, a Democrat, has represented District 136 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since 2011 and is not running for re-election in 2026.
He earned a B.A. in psychology from Yale University and an MBA in marketing from the Stern School of Business, and earned a teaching certificate in history and social studies.
He previously served as a representative on Westport's Representative Town Meeting from 2003 to 2010 and worked in marketing for companies including Revlon and Bristol-Myers Squibb.
